signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a two-story colonial home with attached garage, a long paved driveway and a front lawn.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Lawn is neatly kept and the front garden beds are tidy, but there is no crew, equipment or truck visible. This looks homeowner-maintained.

signals.notes: A white SUV is parked in front of the garage, a basketball hoop stands beside the driveway, and the paver-edged driveway is in good shape. The home has a covered front porch and sits on a wooded lot.
